Kim / Sarah — will do. Quick technical note for our runbook and Finovate IT:
- When a calendar organizer is an external federated address (or when invites are relayed), some GCal clients render a generic button that has an empty href. The most reliable fix is to reissue with the meeting link in the body and attach an .ics that contains the URL explicitly.
- I'll create a Zoom meeting, set myself as host, add Kimberly as co-host, and attach reissued_zoom_invite.ics. That avoids relying on Google organizer transfer, which Finovate may have disabled.

Attaching the new .ics now and pasting the join link below in plain text until calendar propagation completes.

Kim — please use the attached .ics when you update the event in your calendar so the attendee list is updated.
